TurnDetectionConfig: configures how turn boundaries are detected during duplex streaming
TurnDetectionConfig.mode is a string with default 'asm'
TurnDetectionConfig.mode accepts 'vad' or 'asm'
The mode value applies only when the turn_detection block is present
TurnDetectionConfig.vad has type VADConfig and applies when mode is vad
Mode 'asm' is provider-native: the provider handles turn detection internally
Gemini's automaticActivityDetection is the provider-native mechanism used for asm mode
With mode 'asm' the arena adds no AudioTurnStage
Mode 'vad' is named Voice Activity Detection and is client-side
With mode 'vad' the arena adds an AudioTurnStage
Turn detection defaults to client-side VAD when the turn_detection block is omitted
A turn_detection block whose mode is empty or 'asm' uses ASM

Supported audio file formats are .wav, .pcm and .raw
AudioFileSource parses the WAV header and extracts the data chunk
Raw .pcm and .raw files carry no header
Other audio extensions are rejected with the error 'unsupported audio format: ... (supported: .wav, .pcm, .raw)'
Decoding follows the file extension
Every chunk read from a file is labelled 16000 Hz
The WAV header's sample rate is not used
The Gemini encoder accepts only 16000 Hz audio
Raw .pcm and .raw files hold 16-bit samples
WAV files with 24-bit, 32-bit or float32 samples are converted to 16-bit PCM by AudioFileSource
Every chunk is labelled one channel (mono)
Audio is not downmixed
mime_type is required by the schema
Decoding follows the file extension
The mime_type field labels the stored audio
Source files are 16 kHz mono, 16-bit for raw files and 16/24/32-bit or float32 for WAV
ffmpeg command 'ffmpeg -i input.wav -f s16le -ar 16000 -ac 1 output.pcm' produces 16-bit 16 kHz mono raw PCM
ffmpeg command 'ffmpeg -i input.mp3 -f s16le -ar 16000 -ac 1 output.pcm' converts MP3 to raw PCM
ffprobe command 'ffprobe -show_streams input.wav' reports sample rate, channels and sample format

The duplex executor builds the pipeline from the listed stages, in the listed order
A stage with a condition is added only when that condition holds
Stage AudioPacingStage (audio-pacing) is added when the arena config has no enabled self_play section or an audio monitor is attached
AudioPacingStage (audio-pacing) emits each input audio chunk at real-time cadence implied by its size and sample rate
Stage MonitorTap (input) is added when an audio monitor is attached and copies input audio to the audio monitor
Stage AudioResampleStage is always added
AudioResampleStage resamples to the provider's preferred rate: Gemini 16000 Hz, OpenAI realtime 24000 Hz
AudioResampleStage passes audio through when the rates match
Stage AudioTurnStage is added when turn_detection.mode is vad or the turn_detection block is omitted
AudioTurnStage detects turn boundaries using the VAD settings
Stage VariableProviderStage is always added and supplies the merged scenario variables
Stage PromptAssemblyStage is always added and loads the prompt template into the shared TurnState
TurnState has fields Template, AllowedTools and Validators
Stage TemplateStage is always added and renders the system prompt into TurnState.SystemPrompt
Stage DuplexProviderStage is always added and opens a StreamInputSupport session
DuplexProviderStage reads TurnState.SystemPrompt at session creation
Stage AudioPacingStage (audio-pacing-output) has the same condition as the input AudioPacingStage
AudioPacingStage (audio-pacing-output) emits each response audio chunk at real-time cadence
Stage MonitorTap (output) is added when an audio monitor is attached and copies response audio to the audio monitor
Stage MediaExternalizerStage is added when media storage is set and writes all media to storage, retained
Stage ArenaStateStoreSaveStage is added when a state store is configured and saves the conversation messages
An audio monitor is attached when promptarena run or promptarena serve has --audio-monitor on
promptarena run and promptarena serve both accept the --audio-monitor flag
--audio-monitor accepts 'auto', which is the default, and attaches a monitor when stdout is a terminal
promptarena serve is a subcommand
promptarena run is a subcommand
Runs started by promptarena run set media storage to the media directory under the output directory
Runs started by promptarena run configure a state store
